title: Quality of Recipes [QoR]
description: Adds 90+ Recipes that will make your gameplay slightly better and more convenient.
body:
![QoR DATAPACK](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93b3ac87f4021152d52d80620676d563e30c9744.png)

# ✨ Quality of Recipes ✨

Tired of endless grinding for a single item? Want Minecraft's crafting system to feel more logical, rewarding, and smooth? **Quality of Recipes** is a vanilla-friendly datapack designed to remove annoying routine and add common-sense recipes without breaking the game's balance!

---

## 🚀 Key Features

*   **Logical Alternatives:** Craft rare, uncraftable, or hard-to-get vanilla items using realistic component combinations.
*   **Recycling & Deconstruction:** Uncraft or smelt some of the items back into their base ingredients!
*   **Campfire Mechanics:** Utilize the campfire and smoker for fuel-free drying, baking, and eco-friendly processing.

---

## 🛠️ What Inside?

Here is all of the recipes that this datapack adds and changes:


*   🌱 **Nature and Farming:**
  
    1) *Green Dye*: Smelt Sapplings, Leaves or Wheat, or craft with Lilypad.
    2) *String*: Craft with 3 Grass or use Smoker using Vines.
    3) *Leather*: Cook Rotten flesh on Campfire
    4) *Grass block, Podzol, Mycelium*: Crafted with Dirt, Bonemeal and Wheat seeds; Brown mushroom; Spruce leaves respectively
    5) *Bread*: Can now be made with any position of 3 Wheat, even in 2x2 grid
    6) *Glow Berry*: Crafted with a Sweet berry, surrounded by 8 Gold nuggets
    7) *Budding Amethyst*: Crafted with an Amethyst block, surrounded by 8 Amethyst
    8) *Cookie*: Now player is given 16 instead of 8. Same recipe
    9) *Spore Blossom*: Crafted with 3 Moss blocks, 2 Glow lychen and a Pink dye
    10) *Sea pickle*: Crafted with a Seagrass and Glowing ink sack
    11) *Dead bush*: Cook Grass or Fern on a Campfire


  
*  ✨ **Craft Uncraftable!:** 

    1) *Totem of Undying*: Crafted with 2 Emerald blocks, 1 Gold Ingot, 3 Gold Blocks and a Golden apple
    2) *Trident*: Crafted with 3 Prismarine shards, a Heart of Sea, 2 Prismarine blocks and with an Iron block
    3) *Player, Skeleton, Zombie, Creeper, Piglin head*: Would be too much to write in here, see recipes in Knowledge book or JEI
    4) *Nametag*: Crafted with a Paper and a Gold nugget or Iron nugget
    5) *Saddle*: Crafted with 3 Leather and an Iron ingot
    6) *Bell*: Crafted with 3 Wood, 4 Sticks and a Gold block
    7) *Elytra*: Crafted with 4 Phantom membrane, a Netherite ingot, Iron chestplate, Dragon's breath
    8) *Slimeball*: Crafted with 2 Lime dyes, a Magma cream and Water bucket
    9) *Flint*: Crafted with 3 Gravel in any position
    10) *Cobbled deepslate*: Crafted with 2 Coal and a Cobblestone
    11) *Ice*: crafted with a Snow
    12) *Chainmail armor*: Crafted with Iron nuggets in a shape like an armor with combining Leather armor
    13) *Iron, Gold, Diamond Horse armor*: Crafted with 6 Iron, Gold Ingots; Diamonds and with a Leather Horse armor
    14) *Sponge*: Crafted with a Seagrass, surrounded by 8 Yellow dyes
    15) *Cobweb*: Crafted with 5 String in a cross shape
    16) *Crying obsidian*: Crafted with an Obsidian and Amethyst


*  🔧 **Tweaks and Changes:**

    1) *Map*: Now easier, craft it with a Black dye instead of Compass
    2) *Quartz from Diorite*: Smelt Diorite to get Quartz
    3) *Redstone from Granite*: Smelt Granite to get Redstone
    4) *Iron nugget from Andesite*: Smelt Andesite to get Iron nugget
    5) *Ender chest*: Now the recipes makes 2 of them in order to make it easier to connect and use
    6) *Any Moss stone block variant*: Combine Cobblestone stairs, walls and etc. with Vines
    7) *Trapdoors*: Now cheaper in price, 6 planks now give 4 Trapdoors instead of 2
    8) *Spyglass*: Spyglass now has more accurate recipe, crafted with 2 Amethyst, a Glass pane, Copper and Gold ingot. Yes, it's more expensive but has common-sense
    9) *Netherite ingot*: Easier to craft, combine 3 Gold ingots and 3 Netherite scrap
    10) *Netherite upgrade*: Now you need 3 Diamonds to dupe it instead of 7
    11) *Jukebox*: Much more common-sense, Iron ingot instead of a valuable Diamond
    12) *Coal*: Cook any log on a campfire, or use a primitive way -- combine 6 Sticks with a Cobblestone
    13) *Glass*: Can be made in Blast furnace. Faster that in an ordinary Furnace!
    14) *Packed and Blue ice*: Now takes 4 Ice/Packed ice to craft Packed/Blue ice instead of 9
    15) *Sponge*: You can dry Wet sponge by cooking it on a Campfire
    16) *Brick, Bricks block, Nether brick*: Cook Clay, Clay block, Netherrack on a Campfire
    17) *Easier Compass and Clock*: Both recipes use Iron nugget instead of Compass
    18) *Red dye*: Crafted with a Redstone or a Red mushroom
    19) *Clay*: Crafted with a Mud with Any Sand


*  ♻️ **Recycling:**

    1) *Any 2 Slab*: Combine 2 slabs together to get a full Planks
    2) *String*: Can be crafted with a Wool
    3) *Brick*: 4 Bricks can be crafted using a Bricks block

---

## 🗺️ Compatibility

*   **Minecraft Versions:** Optimized for 1.21 and 1.21.1 versions of Minecraft.
*   **Mod Compatibility:** May cause problems with identical recipes from modpacks or datapacks, but can be fixed by downloading **Polymorth**.
